mapper.insert: insert into agent_run_context ( org_id, run_id, status, snapshot_json, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{orgId}, #{runId}, #{status}, #{snapshotJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on duplicate key update status = values(status), snapshot_json = values(snapshot_json), updated_at = values(updated_at)
mapper.select: select id, org_id, run_id, status, snapshot_json, created_at, updated_at from agent_run_context where org_id = #{orgId} and run_id = #{runId} limit 1
